title: More ways to make video, speech, and music
summary:
New video, speech, and music models led the day, alongside wider GPT-6 access and less surprising CLI and generation behavior.

MiniMax H3 Max adds video generation from text, frames, and reference media, with synchronized audio. Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Lite add speech generation with 30 voices and style instructions, while Lyria 3.5 adds text-to-MP3 song generation. All four models are paid-only.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna now accept Quest Pollen accounts without requiring a paid balance. A pinned Enter notice sets out planned changes: Nova Canvas and Nova Reel are scheduled for removal on September 30; on October 1, the existing MAI Image 2.5 Flash ID is scheduled to route to 2.6 Flash. The available-model documentation was also refreshed.

`polli gen text` now honors explicit streaming choices when output is piped and reports model, token, and saved-file details consistently in JSON. The CLI also catches invalid options before making requests, names audio files according to their format, and exits with an error when playback fails.

daily.title: MiniMax H3 Max video
daily.text: Create 5-, 10-, or 15-second videos with synchronized audio from text, frames, or reference media using `minimax/minimax-h3-max`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-h3-max).

daily.title: Gemini 3.8 speech
daily.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Lite TTS offer 30 voices and style instructions. Speech defaults to WAV, with raw 24 kHz PCM also supported. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: GPT-6 with Quest Pollen
daily.text: Use GPT-6 Sol and Luna with Quest Pollen without needing a paid balance. Their existing model IDs stay the same. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Lyria 3.5 songs
daily.text: Generate an MP3 song from a text prompt with `google/lyria-3.5`. Describe the approximate length in the prompt rather than setting an explicit duration. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/lyria-3.5).
